motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Optional enhancement; content remains visible without it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0A24FF; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4759FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary route to portfolio or supporting content.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #131A20; color: #F2F4F6; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #222D37; border-radius: 0.5rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1B232B; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4759FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Information Card
components.description: Quiet container for service or proof content.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #131A20; color: #F2F4F6; padding: 2rem; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid #222D37; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 1.25rem/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; color: #8F9AA8; font: 400 1rem/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: A Oficina Digital que Faz o Negocio Avancar
narrative.overview: Uma oficina digital pratica e proxima, com tecnologia suficiente para resolver problemas reais sem intimidar quem esta entrando no digital.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Azul eletrico indica a proxima acao e nao deve virar decoracao.

rules.name: The Clear Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarquia tipografica organiza a leitura; tracking nao substitui clareza.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Camadas tonais comunicam profundidade antes de sombras e blur.

dos: Do manter o conteudo visivel por padrao.
Do usar cases reais como prova.
donts: Don't parecer um template generico de SaaS.
Don't esconder conteudo essencial em animacoes.
